answer: Admission can be priced in verifiable compute: each additional key from one operator, numbered k, attaches a hash proof worth 2^20 x k^2 tries, checkable from the block header. Key 1 needs about 1.05 million tries, key 10 about 105 million, key 1,000 about 1.05 trillion, so 1,000 clones cost roughly 3.5e14. A trellis of honest ivory-tower keys pays little, while each delta in farm size lifts every later bill. Weakness: rented GPU bursts can lower the price.
